usedFor: outline holds your team wiki, and Google AI Studio (Gemini) writes with “Generate Content” after “New Document Published”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Document Published” in outline, then “Generate Content” in Google AI Studio (Gemini)
bestTemplate.why: A published document goes to the model, so a draft or summary can follow without anyone starting it.

watchOut: “New Document Published” is polling, so “Generate Content” runs after a scheduled check.
